cleavage_agent: Tryptic peptides were generated following the FASP protocol of Wiśniewski et al., with minor modifications as described by Hamann et al..
labeling: inferred: For protein abundance estimates, normalized spectral abundance factors (NSAFs) were calculated per sample and organism (%orgNSAF).
reduction_concentration: Tissues were disrupted by bead beating for 45–s at 6.0–m/s with lysing matrix D tubes (MP Biomedicals) in SDT buffer (4% [wt/vol] sodium dodecyl sulfate [SDS], 100–mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6, 0.1–M dithiothreitol [DTT])
